# M. Khaidar — Portfolio

> Personal portfolio and project index for M. Khaidar, a full-stack developer and product engineer based in Ternate, Indonesia. Builds web applications with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Supabase.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://hydr.codes/): about, journey, experience, selected projects, FAQ, and contact.
- [Projects](https://hydr.codes/projects): all projects with stack, status, and links.
- [Blogroll](https://hydr.codes/blogroll): curated friends, communities, tools, and learning resources.
- [Guestbook](https://hydr.codes/guestbook): visitor messages.

## Selected project pages

- [Cup of Code](https://hydr.codes/projects/cupofcode): publication and resources for Indonesian developers.
- [cv4every1](https://hydr.codes/projects/cv4e1): local-first CV builder with ATS and Creative output.
- [UniVertex](https://hydr.codes/projects/univertex): campus e-voting platform with role-based access.
- [SasaHub](https://hydr.codes/projects/wargahub): civic and community service platform.
- [PASIAR Ternate](https://hydr.codes/projects/pasiar-ternate): local culture and information portal.
- [RINDANG](https://hydr.codes/projects/rindang): digital agriculture platform.
